title: acoustic_indices records (analysis/indices.jsonl)
description: One record per closed epoch-aligned interval (default 300 s) from the analyzer's `indices` plugin (analysis/indices.py): standard ecoacoustic indices of the 8-beam mean signal over the interval's 5 s windows, as p10 / p50 / p90 over the used windows. Windows the tagger flagged as speech are excluded (counted, their numbers never stored), dead and non-finite windows are counted and excluded, and an interval without a used window writes no record. Descriptive soundscape-state numbers: they correlate weakly with biodiversity and a loud insect chorus saturates them (see the spec). Metadata only; no audio. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

unit_stat.description: p10 / p50 / p90 of one index over the used windows of the interval (linear interpolation, so p10 <= p50 <= p90); the other *_stat types differ only in their range.

t.description: End of the interval, Unix seconds (t0 + span_s).

t0.description: Start of the epoch-aligned interval: a multiple of span_s.

partial.description: Optional, present only when true: the interval is incomplete (flushed at analyzer shutdown, or the analyzer started late in it); win_total says how many windows it holds.

win_s.description: Length of one analysed window in seconds (5).

win_used.description: Windows in the aggregate; at least 1 because an interval without one writes no record.

win_untagged.description: Windows excluded because the tagger windows did not cover them end to end (speech gate fails closed); 0 when speech_gate is false.

speech_gate.description: true: the tagger's speech flags were applied; false: the plugin ran without the tagger (--indices-without-speech-gate) and nothing was excluded as speech.
